environment.content: Synthetic synchronized flash and beep; not Minecraft gameplay

caveats: CPU sampled from /proc at one-second intervals; one core = 100%; low-complexity synthetic content is not a Minecraft performance benchmark.
Peak RSS is encoder process RSS, not total pipeline memory or GPU allocations.
Video marker quantization is roughly 67ms. Stable drift does not remove the ~330ms fixed fixture offset.
First browser frame timing starts before pressing Watch on an already-publishing channel; not cold startup or glass-to-glass latency.
No OBS application or Twitch transmission verified.
